composite_prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: S01 exterior NIGHT variant of the existing full composite C.
Input Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, not a loose reference. Preserve its exact camera, composition, object positions, architecture, door and window shapes, tree branches and canopy silhouette, vine, crescent hanging sign, pots, paving and image dimensions. Change ONLY time of day and painted light colors.
Make it quiet early night: muted dusty-teal sky, cool warm-grey and teal shadows, the same arched ground-floor window and two upstairs windows carry a soft flat ochre-cream interior-light color. Do not emit light beams or add glow around them. Door remains closed exactly as in the day target. Keep the rightmost wall and bottom lane low detail. No additional lantern, objects, stars, moon, letters or plaques. Preserve the existing cloud as a dim soft grey shape.
STYLE_V2: gouache picture-book illustration, visible brush strokes and dry-brush edges, slightly wobbly hand-drawn colored-pencil outlines, simplified shapes, slightly imperfect perspective, limited palette of seven muted colors (cream, warm grey, walnut brown, sage green, dusty teal, faded plum, ochre), soft diffuse painted night lighting, cool-tinted shadows, generous empty wall and floor space, only a few props, one clear focal point, calm and quiet, matte paper texture, no text, no people.
NEGATIVE: glow, bloom, light rays, god rays, lens flare, bokeh, depth of field blur, gold filigree, ornate carvings, glossy or plastic surfaces, hyper-detailed clutter, photorealism, symmetrical fantasy composition, extra wisteria, text, letters, numbers, UI, labels, blank plaques, interface frames, borders.
Output a single edge-to-edge landscape image at the same native dimensions as Image 1.
cleanplate_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: S01 NIGHT raw cleanplate B_all for actual same-position extraction of game layers.
Input Image 1 is the exact EDIT TARGET. This is a local removal/edit, not a new scene. Remove ALL of these movable pieces from the existing painting and fill their previous locations with the plausible wall, roof, timber or sky behind them:
1. The leafy tree canopy at upper-left; retain the static main bare trunk and thick branches wherever visible, but remove the leaves.
2. The entire wisteria vine immediately above and down the left side of the entrance, including leaves, flowers and its winding vine stem. Restore the simple plaster and timber behind it.
3. The small crescent-shaped hanging wooden sign at upper-right of the door, including its little hanging chain and supporting metal bracket; restore plain cream wall.
4. The small white cloud in the sky.
Keep the entrance door and ring handle, all window panes and frames, stone wall, timber structure, roof, both herb pots, cobbled foreground, overall camera and crop EXACTLY as they are. Preserve all unedited pixels as closely as possible. Add no new objects, openings, labels or decoration. This remains the same NIGHT lighting, with all three original window interiors still ON in flat ochre-cream. Keep their frame geometry and painted intensity unchanged. Do not alter lamp states or the colors of the remaining objects.
Maintain Image 1's matte gouache strokes, dry-brush marks, slightly wobbly colored-pencil edges and limited muted palette. Full-bleed landscape at the same native dimensions. No text, UI, plaques, frames, borders, people, glow, bloom or photorealism.
annotation_notes: Third actual processing round (initial real1 was only a visual annotation). Tree/vine ownership made disjoint; pale flower hues included through 255; crescent uses actual brown source contour instead of rectangular wall patch. Raster-run polygons encode actual native hard-mask rows; no art pixels generated.
